title: UPDATE: Musk and Zuckerberg Adopt 'Super Intelligence' Terminology on Earnings Calls

tickers.name: Meta Platforms, Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
A handful of high-profile technology leaders have begun updating their public corporate language to align with a federal effort to rename the artificial intelligence industry. Elon Musk and Mark Zuckerberg both used the phrase "super intelligence" to describe the technology during recent earnings calls, although other executives in the sector continued to use the traditional "AI" label during their financial briefings.

The shifts follow a directive from President Donald Trump to officially ban the terms "Artificial Intelligence" and "AI" from government records, which he described as an inaccurate name. Adoption of the new terminology has varied across federal agencies; while the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau updated its website to the "SI" branding, the agency did not revise a compliance plan published on Sept. 26.
